007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ConversationAttributes;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for updating Select AI conversation attributes.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
021 * {@link Conversation} object for an existing conversation, build a
022 * {@link ConversationAttributes} payload, call
023 * {@link Conversation#setAttributes(ConversationAttributes)}, and print whether
024 * the update succeeded.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>This sample changes database state by updating the conversation identified
027 * by {@code SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID}. Verify the conversation ID before
028 * running it.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
031 * <ul>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID</li>
036 * </ul>
037 *
038 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
039 * <ul>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE - defaults to an updated sample title.</li>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION - defaults to an updated sample
042 *       description.</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS - defaults to {@code 7}.</li>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH - defaults to {@code 20}.</li>
045 * </ul>
046 *
047 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
048 * <pre>{@code
049 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
050 * }</pre>
051 *
052 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
053 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
054 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
055 * <pre>{@code
056 * mvn clean install
057 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
058 * }</pre>
059 *
060 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
061 * <pre>{@code
062 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
063 *   -d samples/out \
064 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/conversation/SetConversationAttributesSample.java
065 * }</pre>
066 *
067 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
068 * <pre>{@code
069 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
070 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation.SetConversationAttributesSample
071 * }</pre>
072 *
073 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
074 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
075 * and diagnostics.</p>
076 */
077public final class SetConversationAttributesSample {
078    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SetConversationAttributesSample.class);
079
080    private SetConversationAttributesSample() {
081    }
082
083    public static void main(String[] args) {
084        String conversationId = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID");
085
086        try {
087            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
088            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(conversationId);
089            ConversationAttributes attributes = buildConversationAttributes();
090            boolean updated = conversation.setAttributes(attributes);
091
092            System.out.printf("Set attributes on conversation '%s' completed: %s%n", conversationId, updated);
093            System.out.printf("Attribute payload: %s%n", attributes.toJson());
094        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
095            LOGGER.error("Failed to update attributes for Select AI conversation '{}'.", conversationId, e);
096        }
097    }
098
099    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
100        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
101                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
102                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
103                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
104                .build();
105
106        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
107    }
108
109    private static ConversationAttributes buildConversationAttributes() {
110        return ConversationAttributes.builder()
111                .title(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE", "Updated Java SDK Sample Conversation"))
112                .description(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION",
113                        "Conversation updated by the Java Select AI SDK sample."))
114                .retentionDays(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS", "7")))
115                .conversationLength(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH", "20")))
116                .build();
117    }
118
119    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
120        String value = System.getenv(name);
121        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
122            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
123        }
124        return value;
125    }
126
127    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
128        String value = System.getenv(name);
129        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
130    }
131}
